يضطلع (form VIII)

# يُضْطَلَعُ (yuḍṭalaʕu) /judˤ.tˤa.la.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# يَضْطَلِعَ (yaḍṭaliʕa) /jadˤ.tˤa.li.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
